seller.offer: Focused customer-acquisition experiments for B2B and SaaS teams to identify scalable growth drivers. The service moves through a structured process (Inspect, Assemble, Test, Calibrate, Launch) to isolate whether the ICP, message, offer, or channel is the bottleneck. Offerings include GTM Booster (audit and prioritization), GTM Raptor (execution of one focused experiment), and GTM Starship (recurring experimentation and scaling).
seller.target: B2B and SaaS companies of any size or stage, including specialized business software, seeking more predictable customer acquisition and evidence-based growth rather than volume-based activity.
